name: Feeding The Poor
overview: Scripture reveals that feeding the poor is an act of honoring God, as showing mercy to those in need reflects reverence for the Maker (Proverbs 14:31). Giving to the poor is likened to lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such generosity (Proverbs 19:17). Those who generously share their resources with the poor are blessed and will not lack, while neglecting the needy brings curses (Proverbs 22:9; 28:27). Even in times of celebration, God’s people are called to remember the poor by sending gifts and portions to them, demonstrating joy through generosity (Esther 9:22). Jesus’ example of meeting the needs of the multitudes underscores the importance of compassionate provision (Matthew 14:13).
